svg.title: The whole system on one map
svg.desc: Customers, salespeople and the owner reach n8n workflows through a calculator, a showroom tablet, Gmail and approval links. n8n calls SQL functions in Supabase (PostgreSQL), which is the single source of truth. A local AI model is called through one sub-workflow and its output is validated. Notifications are queued in the database and delivered to Gmail and Slack.
svg.text: no API key; every answer is validated in code
bad output takes a safe path, never a silent skip
status page reads its stage by token (anon RPC)
Logos: Simple Icons (CC0). All names and data are fictional.
